items.title: 12.1 Nucleus ki banawat aur khusoosiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.1 with the chapter opening (PDF 262).

blocks.text: Hum samajhte hain ke tamam atoms neutrons, protons aur electrons se bane hain. In teen zarron ke antiparticles bhi maloom hain. Positron (musbat electron), neutrino aur photon bhi maloom hain. 1960s ke aakhir tak neutron aur proton jaise bohat se naye zarre daryaft ho chuke the; inhein mesons kaha gaya, jin ke masses zyada tar nucleons se kam magar electron se zyada the. Baad mein aise mesons bhi mile jin ke masses nucleons se zyada hain. Physicists ne zyada bunyadi zarron, yaani chhote ajza, ki talash shuru ki, jin ki baad mein tajrubat se tasdeeq hui aur unhein quarks ka naam diya gaya. Yeh chapter maadde ki bunyadi eenton (building blocks) par baat karta hai.

Atom ka nucleus do qism ke zarron par mushtamil hai: protons aur neutrons. Proton sab se saada atom, hydrogen, jise protium kehte hain, ka nucleus hai. Proton par electron ke barabar miqdar ka musbat charge (1.6 x 10^-19 C) hai, aur us ka mass 1.67 x 10^-27 kg hai. Neutron, jis ka wujood 1932 mein James Chadwick ne bataya, apne naam ki tarah bijli ke lihaz se neutral hai, aur us ka mass taqreeban proton jitna hai. Nucleus ke do qism ke zarre, neutrons aur protons, nucleons kehlate hain.

Hydrogen ka nucleus ek proton par mushtamil hai; baqi tamam elements ke nuclei neutrons aur protons dono par. Mukhtalif nuclei nuclides kehlate hain. Nucleus mein protons ki tadaad atomic number Z kehlati hai. Nucleons ki kul tadaad, neutrons aur protons ka majmooa, A se zahir hoti hai aur atomic mass number, ya sirf mass number, kehlati hai. Neutron number N = A - Z ... (12.1) hai. Kisi nucleus ko zahir karne ke liye element ki kimiyai alamat X ke saath oopar A aur neeche Z likha jata hai.

blocks.title: Unified mass unit
blocks.text: Atomi zarron ke masses zahir karne ke liye kilogram ki bajaye unified mass scale (u) aam istemal hota hai. Tareef ke mutabiq 1 u carbon-12 atom ke mass ka theek barahwan hissa hai: 1 u = 1.6606 x 10^-27 kg (931 MeV ke barabar). Is unit mein proton ka mass 1.007276 u, neutron ka 1.008665 u aur electron ka 0.00055 u hai.

blocks.title: Isotopes
blocks.text: Jin nuclei mein protons ki tadaad ek magar neutrons ki tadaad mukhtalif ho, unhein isotopes kehte hain. Carbon ke nuclei mein hamesha 6 protons hote hain magar 6, 7 ya 8 neutrons ho sakte hain: carbon ke isotopes carbon-12, carbon-13 aur carbon-14 hain. In mein carbon-12 aur carbon-13 paidar (stable) hain, magar carbon-14 na-paidar hai aur beta aur neutrino zarre kharij kar ke nitrogen mein badal jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ke mukhtalif isotopes mein kya mushtarak hai aur kya mukhtalif (short question 12.1)? Woh element pehchaniye jis mein 87 nucleons aur 50 neutrons hain (short question 12.2).
blocks.explanation: Isotopes mein protons ki tadaad ek hai, to atomic number, electrons ki tarteeb aur kimiya ek hai; neutrons ki tadaad mukhtalif hai, to mass number, mass aur nuclear paidari mukhtalif (carbon-12 aur carbon-13 paidar, carbon-14 radioactive). Z = A - N = 87 - 50 = 37: element rubidium hai, rubidium-87.

items: Nucleus: protons (+e, 1.67 x 10^-27 kg) aur neutrons (neutral, Chadwick 1932), mil kar nucleons. Z = atomic number, A = mass number, N = A - Z (12.1); nuclides; alamat X ke saath A aur Z.

1 u = carbon-12 atom ka 1/12 = 1.6606 x 10^-27 kg (931 MeV); proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, electron 0.00055 u. Isotopes: ek Z, mukhtalif N (carbon-12, 13, 14; carbon-14 beta decay se nitrogen).
